Data owner may implement equivalent minimal durable receipt preserving these exact invariants, but an implementation changing the shape needs root release.
details.resolverEvidence: Extend internal safe facts with a positively constructed not-entered-value-read ID set. Mark entry before each existing value read; construct negatives only from the exact accepted declaration iterator and actual synchronous resolver/literal verification control flow. IDs with a real resolution decision are handled as linked facts. Do not infer no read from absent decisionFacts or missing FINAL. details.existingAtomicity: Current settleObservedFailure now locks actual resolution owner and wraps append+close/requeue in one transaction with applied==1 or rollback. This is approved direction, not independent integration certification; actual DispatcherIT/races still required.

Per-ID read-entry facts originate only in the bounded actual resolver control flow; SQL verifies durable accepted declaration/attempt/owner/transition identity and never claims it measured Vault physically. Prove counters in actual integration tests. Real attempted decisions stay linked and real pre-send erasure retained.
